entities.name: NAS ciphering algorithm
entities.description: Algorithm used for ciphering NAS messages. Takes input parameters including BEARER ID, DIRECTION bit, NAS COUNT, NAS encryption key, and key stream length.

entities.name: NAS deciphering algorithm
entities.description: Algorithm used for deciphering NAS messages. Uses NAS sequence number and estimated NAS overflow counter to form NAS COUNT input.

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Input parameter for NAS ciphering and deciphering algorithms. Used by sender from local storage and by receiver from sequence number and overflow counter estimate.

entities.name: BEARER ID
entities.description: Input parameter to NAS ciphering algorithm identifying the bearer.

entities.name: DIRECTION bit
entities.description: Input parameter to NAS ciphering algorithm indicating direction of transmission.

entities.name: NAS encryption key
entities.description: Key used as input to NAS ciphering algorithm for encryption.

entities.name: Key stream length
entities.description: Length of key stream generated by encryption algorithm. Set based on message type and container IE being ciphered.

entities.name: NAS message container IE
entities.description: Information element containing plain NAS message for ciphering in initial NAS message protection.

entities.name: CIoT small data container IE
entities.description: Information element used in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message for ciphering initial NAS message protection.

entities.name: Initial NAS message protection
entities.description: Procedure applying ciphering to REGISTRATION REQUEST, SERVICE REQUEST, or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST messages.
